name: app-store-connect-status
title: App Store Connect Status
description: View the status of your apps in App Store Connect
author: danilorequena

commands.name: apps
commands.title: View App Status
commands.description: Display all apps with their current App Store status

preferences.name: issuerId
preferences.title: Issuer ID
preferences.description: Your App Store Connect API Issuer ID (UUID format). Find it in Users and Access > Integrations > App Store Connect API

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key ID
preferences.description: Your App Store Connect API Key ID

preferences.name: privateKey
preferences.title: Private Key
preferences.description: The contents of your .p8 private key file (paste the entire content including BEGIN/END lines)

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
